title: What came between Kampili and Thanjavur Maratha kingdom?
question: What came between Kampili and Thanjavur Maratha kingdom?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Kampili (1294) to Thanjavur Maratha kingdom (1674): 0 of cause and effect, 3 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
